source_repository_description: Francis O'Neill's Music of Ireland and Dance Music of Ireland transcribed to ABC

license.literal_text_plain: The original O'Neill's Music of Ireland has been out of copyright for many years now. This collection of ABC transcriptions is copyrighted 1997-2000 by the contributors to the project. You are welcome to download anything here and use it, as long as you give credit to the transcribers, and take credit for any corrections or enhancements that you might make.
license.html_tag_note: The quoted paragraph appears verbatim in 1850/editorial/HEADER; the only markup in it is the inline ... around the book title, which is reproduced in literal_text_with_html and stripped in literal_text_plain.
license.note: The repository contains no LICENSE, COPYING or README file, and the GitHub project page carries no license declaration. The only licensing statement found anywhere in the repository is the paragraph quoted above, located in 1850/editorial/HEADER (byte-identical text also in 1850/editorial/HEADER.html). It states the underlying 1903 collection is out of copyright (public domain) while the ABC transcriptions themselves are copyrighted 1997-2000 by the project contributors, granting a permissive right to download and use the transcriptions provided credit is given to the transcribers.

criteria: must contain an X: header line
must contain at least 8 note tokens in the body

duplicates_dir_not_processed.reason: alternate transcriptions (by other transcribers) of tunes already present in 1850/abc; not included to avoid duplicate melodies

skipped_detail.reason: no X: header line (source file begins ':1646' with the leading 'X' missing), so it does not satisfy the X: requirement

output_encoding: UTF-8, no BOM, LF line endings
filename_rule: [a-z0-9_-] only; names prefixed dmoi_ (Dance Music of Ireland/1001) or moi_ (Music of Ireland/1850)
